The Story of a man with Hadhrat Ya'la bin Munya (RA)

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Daylami narrates that Hadhrat Ya'la bin Munya (RA) said, "I was an old man with no servant when Rasulullaah ﷺ announced that an expedition was to leave. I therefore looked for someone to hire and stipulated that he would receive a full share from the booty. I finally found someone. When the time was close for our departure, he came to me and said, 'I have no idea whether there shall be any booty and I cannot say what my share will be. Why don't you rather specify a fixed amount that I would receive whether there is any booty or not.' I therefore fixed an amount of three Dinaars. When (my share of) the booty came to me, I intended to give him his complete share but then remembered the three Dinaars. For this reason, I approached Rasulullaah ﷺ and narrated the account to him. Rasulullaah ﷺ said, 'I see nothing in this world and in the Aakhirah for him as reward for this expedition besides the three Dinaars that he has specified (these Dinaars are all that he will receive).'"[^2]
Those Who Proceed in the path of Allaah Using the Wealth of Others
Hadhrat Maymoona bint Sa'd (RA) Asks Rasulullaah ﷺ about this

Hadhrat Maymoona bint Sa'd (RA) reports that she once asked, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Inform us about a person who cannot proceed in the path of Allaah but sponsors the means by which Jihaad can be carried out. Will this person receive the reward or the person who actually goes out?" Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "He shall receive the reward for his wealth while the one who goes out shall be rewarded for the intention he makes (he shall therefore receive no rewards if his intentions are incorrect)."[^3]
The Story of Hadhrat Ali (RA) and Another Man

Hadhrat Ali bin Abi Rabee'ah (RA) narrates that a man once came to Hadhrat Ali bin Abi Taalib (RA) with his son whom he intended to send on an expedition in his place. Hadhrat Ali (RA) said to him, "I prefer the judgement of an adult to the fighting of a youngster."[^4]
